summary.tldr: Adds listed lakes and rivers in British Columbia to the Canadian Navigable Waters Act schedule.
what_it_does: Adds Skaha Lake, Tugulnuit Lake, Vaseux Lake, and Osoyoos Lake to the schedule of navigable waters, with each lake boundary including the mouths of connecting waterways.
Adds Christina Lake, Box Lake, Summit Lake, and Slocan Lake to the schedule, with each lake boundary including the mouths of connecting waterways.
Adds the Okanagan River, Granby River, Christina Creek, Kettle River, Pend d’Oreille River, and Slocan River to the schedule, with the listed start and end points.
Changes the Columbia River entry so it runs from Columbia Lake to the Canada-U.S. border.
who_it_affects: People using the listed lakes and rivers
summary.background: The bill amends the schedule to the Canadian Navigable Waters Act.
